root_cause: The installed `whowhatbench` package's text_evaluator._generate_data() invokes the GenAI generation callback with a `context` keyword argument, but the `genai_gen_text()` helper bundled with the currently resolved `optimum-intel`/`openvino-genai` wheel set does not accept that parameter, raising TypeError on every accuracy_conformance test case (both CPU and GPU devices, all model/precision combinations). PR #39512 only edits docs/sphinx_setup/_static/benchmarks_files/llm_models_7-368H.csv and cannot influence this failure; it is a pre-existing, unresolved dependency-version-skew between whowhatbench and the GenAI model-loader helper, now recorded 7 times since 2026-11-05, with the last two occurrences happening on the same PR within roughly 2 hours of each other (merge-queue re-attempts hit the same unresolved dependency bug every time).
reproduction_steps: 1. Check out the merge-queue commit 8ae1388561686585b04bede1c0e59f5e3cc329fc. 2. Install test deps per tests/llm/requirements.txt (resolved versions match the CI log, e.g. optimum-intel/openvino-genai/whowhatbench as pinned in that run). 3. Run `python3 -m pytest tests/llm/accuracy_conformance.py -k CPU --tb native`. 4. Observe TypeError: genai_gen_text() got an unexpected keyword argument 'context' raised from whowhatbench/text_evaluator.py:236.
recommended_actions: Pin or bump whowhatbench to a version whose text_evaluator._generate_data() matches the current genai_gen_text() signature, or update genai_gen_text() to accept 'context'.
Inspect the model-loader helper that defines genai_gen_text() (resolved from optimum-intel/openvino-genai per tests/llm/requirements.txt) and reconcile its signature with whowhatbench's call site.

Add a fast pre-flight check that calls genai_gen_text() with the exact kwargs whowhatbench's text_evaluator passes, so a future incompatible upgrade fails immediately instead of after the full accuracy suite runs.
This is now a recurring merge-queue-blocking dependency bug (7 occurrences in 8 days, unrelated to the PRs it keeps blocking) — escalate for a dedicated fix rather than relying on reruns.
prevention_strategies: Pin whowhatbench, optimum-intel and openvino-genai together with compatible version ranges in tests/llm/requirements.txt, and add a unit/smoke test asserting the genai_gen_text() signature accepts whowhatbench's expected kwargs, so incompatible dependency bumps are caught before they reach merge-queue LLM accuracy jobs.
historical_context: Identical signature (6cf9cf0d8f5c0a43) previously recorded 6 times between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-13 (runs 41968975027, 42251178965, 42647164506, 42857529315, 43242891184, 43440674345), always in the LLM accuracy CPU/GPU jobs and always categorized Dependencies. This run raises the count to 7 and is the second occurrence against PR #39512 within the last 12 hours, confirming an unresolved, recurring dependency-version-skew that has not yet been fixed upstream and is now actively blocking unrelated merge-queue PRs.
